oA_Group.label: oA Group
oA_Group.description: The 'oA Group' represents a group. It contains an application group ID, a security group ID and a list of multicast and unicast IP addresses that are used in the group. \nAdditionally it contains a list of all members of the group.

Documentary_Description.label: Documentary Description
Documentary_Description.description: Resource to hold a documentary text description of the object.

IP_Addresses.label: IP Addresses
IP_Addresses.description: List of multicast and unicast IPv6 addresses to be used for outgoing group messages

Members.label: Members
Members.description: Link to the local object instances (and/or single resources) that are members of that group in CoRE Link Format [RFC6690](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6690)\nNote: instances and resources not listed here will not be addressable on this node through group messages of this group
